entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
By the oath of the sky which contains the great stars.
And by that Day which is promised.
And by that day which is a witness (i.e. Friday) and by that day in which the people present themselves (i.e. the day of 'Arafah).
May the People of the Trench (of fire) be cursed (who tortured the believers).
Those who lit that blazing fire.
When they were sitting at its borders.
And they themselves are witnesses to what they were doing to the Muslims.
And what did they dislike of the Muslims except this that they believed in Allah, the Most Honourable, the Most Praiseworthy?
That to only Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is Witness upon everything.
Indeed, those who tortured the Muslim men and the Muslim women (by burning them) and then did not repent, for them is the punishment of Hell and for them is the punishment of the Fire.
Indeed, those who believed and did good deeds, for them are gardens beneath which streams flow; this is the great success.
Indeed, the grip of your Lord is very severe.
Indeed, it is He Who originates (creation) and then repeats it (i.e. He will re-create on the Day of Resurrection).
And only He is the Forgiving, the Loving to His pious bondsmen.
The Owner of the Throne, (He is) the Respected.
(He) always does whatever He wills.
Did the story of the armies reach you?
Which armies? (The armies of) Fir'awn and Thamood.
Rather, the disbelievers are (busy) in belying.
And Allah is encompassing them from their backs.
Rather, it (i.e. what the Beloved Prophet Muhammad recites) is a magnificently excellent Qur'aan.
(Written) in the Preserved Tablet.
